title: SWF: ProductInfo and DebugId optional tags
description: Flash 8 SWF export can include ProductInfo (tag 41) and DebugId (tag 63) tags. Check if compile.ts emits them. Write tests in packages/swf/src/__tests__/productinfo.test.ts verifying: (1) SWF compiles without error; (2) if ProductInfo tag exists, its body is non-empty; (3) document these optional tags with todos if not yet emitted.
